title: n8n before 1.123.85, 2.x before 2.43.5, and 2.44.x before 2.44.1 saves the SeaTable Trigger node's API token in error…
description: A vulnerability in n8n versions before 1.123.85, 2.x before 2.43.5, and 2.44.x before 2.44.1 causes the SeaTable Trigger node's API token to be saved in error execution data. This occurs because failed poll requests store raw request headers, exposing the API token to users who can view workflow executions but do not have credential read access.
